subject.title: feat(hooks): emit session prune lifecycle event

question: What pruning-hook contract should OpenClaw accept before this PR can proceed: metadata-only sanitized `session:prune`, trusted raw-content opt-in, or no core pruning hook yet?
rationale: The source gap is real, but the permanent API decides what session/tool metadata or pruned content may leave the context-building path and how much hook latency/failure the model-call path may tolerate.

options.title: Metadata-only active-path hook
options.body: Port the change to `src/agents/agent-hooks/context-pruning/*` and emit only bounded, sanitized counts, timestamp, and typed session metadata with a delivery budget.

options.title: Trusted raw-content opt-in
options.body: Allow pruned content only behind an explicit trusted hook or plugin permission with documented privacy, size, timeout, and logging expectations.

options.title: Defer core hook surface
options.body: Keep scheduled indexing or a plugin-owned workaround until a broader memory/pruning lifecycle API covers prune, reset, and compaction together.

recommendation.title: Metadata-only active-path hook
recommendation.body: Port the change to `src/agents/agent-hooks/context-pruning/*` and emit only bounded, sanitized counts, timestamp, and typed session metadata with a delivery budget.

likelyOwner.reason: Vincent owns the open implementation candidate and has adjacent hook-surface history, making him the best current routing candidate for the contract choice.
